safetyGuidelines.title: High-Voltage Battery
safetyGuidelines.description: Hybrid high-voltage battery located under rear seats. Avoid cutting into rear seat floor area.

safetyGuidelines.title: Emergency Shutoff
safetyGuidelines.description: Turn ignition switch to OFF position to disable high-voltage system and SRS airbags.

safetyGuidelines.title: High-Voltage Battery
safetyGuidelines.description: Full battery pack under cabin floor. Do not puncture or cut through floorboards. Heat build-up can cause thermal runaway.

safetyGuidelines.title: Emergency Fire Loop Cut
safetyGuidelines.description: Cut the low-voltage first-responder loop in the front trunk (frunk) to disable high-voltage safety contactors.

safetyGuidelines.title: SRS Airbags & Pretensioners
safetyGuidelines.description: Avoid cutting into the A, B, and C pillars to prevent accidental deployment of side curtain airbags.

safetyGuidelines.title: High-Voltage Isolation
safetyGuidelines.description: Accessory service disconnect located under the hood. Remove pin connector to isolate high voltage.

safetyGuidelines.title: Frame Cutting Zones
safetyGuidelines.description: Ultra-high-strength steel reinforcement in frame rails. Use heavy-duty hydraulic cutters only at designated cut zones.

safetyGuidelines.title: High-Voltage Service Plug
safetyGuidelines.description: Yellow service plug located under the rear cargo area tray. Pull plug to disable 800V architecture.

safetyGuidelines.title: SRS Airbag Inflators
safetyGuidelines.description: Stored gas inflators located in the roof line above B and C pillars. Do not cut in these areas.

safetyGuidelines.title: Manual Service Disconnect
safetyGuidelines.description: Manual service disconnect lever under front console trim. Pull to isolate 350V battery pack.

safetyGuidelines.title: Side Door Reinforcements
safetyGuidelines.description: High-strength steel intrusion beams in side doors. Avoid cutting door centerlines during extrication.

safetyGuidelines.title: Orange Cables Warning
safetyGuidelines.description: Do not touch, cut, or squeeze orange high-voltage cables running beneath the vehicle passenger compartment.

safetyGuidelines.title: Low-Voltage Battery Disconnect
safetyGuidelines.description: Disconnect the standard 12V lead-acid battery in the engine compartment to turn off safety control systems.
